content.title: 2026 Masters purse payout, breakdown. Winner gets $4.5 million payday
content.text: Updated April 11, 2026, 1:10 p.m. ETThe 2026 Masters purse is a record $22.5 million, with the winner receiving $4.5 million.Rory McIlroy was leading the tournament halfway through, seeking a back-to-back victory.Professional golfers who miss the cut still receive $25,000, while amateurs receive no prize money.In addition to prize money, the Masters champion receives a green jacket, a replica trophy, and a gold coin.If they aren't already, the Masters 2026 winner and runner-up will become multi-millionaires, taking home $4.5 million and $2.43 million, respectively.The Masters purse and payouts by place were released on Saturday, April 11, after the field was cut down to the top 50 players (including ties) following Friday's second round at Augusta National Golf Club.Rory McIlroy was in command of the 90th Masters halfway through the tournament, posting a record 12-under-par score after two rounds. If he wins this year, he would be in rare company as only the fourth player to win back-to-back green jackets.The 2026 Masters purse is a whopping $22.5 million, a record amount for the tournament. For comparison, the purse for 2025 was $21 million.In addition to the prize money and iconic green jacket, Masters champions take home a replica Masters trophy and a gold coin.Here's how much the 2026 Masters winner makes and the Masters payout by place:Masters players who miss the cut still get paidProfessional golfers who miss the cut at the Masters are paid $25,000 each.Do amateurs playing in Masters 2026 get paid?Amateurs who play in the Masters Tournament do not receive monetary prizes.The amateur with the lowest score at the end of the Tournament wins a silver cup. However, for the second year in a row, no amateur made the cut at the Masters.How much prize money will 2026 Masters winner get?The 2026 Masters winner will get a whopping $4.5 million payday. In 2025, Rory McIlroy won $4.2 million for his first Masters victory.Masters 2026 purse, payout by place, prize money distributionThe 2026 Masters purse is $22.5 million.Professional players who missed the cut will receive $25,000 each. Amateur players receive no monetary prizes.Here's the prize money breakdown by place:Pos.
